Quest name: Hunting in Mythology (Chrono Quest - Mythical Era)
Quest location: London Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r6 Search, r8 Appraisal, r4 Theology
Pre-requisite discovery: The Statue of Artemis discovery (from "Statue of the moon goddess" quest) + Wild Boar discovery (from "Wild boar map")
